pass_nocheck_OFF.quantity: RR load minimum after the event, Hopsan no-check circuit with the OFF commands and the quintic sink, per phase against the harness OFF value of the same phase
also_reported_not_gated: RR load at +1.0 and +1.4 s, +-2 kN
pass_nocheck_OFF.rule: if any phase misses, write the cause; no other replay value is then used as an absolute value, only differences within Hopsan

rod_pressure_check.quantity: RR rod chamber pressure at +1.4 s, vent circuit, V1 and OFF commands, bar gauge
rod_pressure_check.reference: about 50 bar g in the harness VR variant, value given by the coordinator
rod_pressure_check.mechanism_question: does the rod check close near 6 bar g, or does it stay open with p_r = p_B

early_release_unit.quantity: RR, extend from rest: line A pressure and fill stroke when the rod check first opens; rod pressure fall
early_release_unit.m1b_rule: p_A = (p_r + p_cr - p_T) / psi, stroke = V_line (p_A - p_T) / (beta_h A_h)
early_release_unit.rule: the formula is not fitted to these runs before the comparison table is written
